change: Extend the existing AC1021 ASCII sparse-MATERIAL straight LWPOLYLINE profile to closed polylines with 3–128 vertices. Require the delivered closed flag, all straight continuous finite segments, exact final-to-first closure, matching physical vertex sequence and source count.
validation: Before the change a generated closed triangle imported but ordinary save refused.

The expanded focused test passes 114 assertions covering edit, save, reopen/resave, closed flag, 128/129 vertices, duplicate and too-short source closure, disconnected live closing segment, destination preservation and same-filter retry, along with the prior open and delivery controls.
The system-codec MATERIAL selector passes 2885 assertions in 15 cases on macOS ARM64; the bundled-codec filter translation unit compiles.

ezdxf 1.4.5 independently checks 3-vertex edited and 128-vertex resaved closed polylines, ordered coordinates, closure and entity/header/layer/dictionary MATERIAL references; both audits have zero errors and fixes.
limits: Generated default-appearance AC1021 ASCII model-space straight polylines only. Curved, nonzero width/elevation, extra metadata, ambiguous or short closure, 129+ vertices, other versions and broader graph profiles remain guarded.
No native GUI or external producer qualification is implied; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed and no package gate or broad support claim is promoted.
